mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) above 2.0% annualized growth indicates robust economic activity that boosts corporate earnings and investor risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2.0% annualized, or 3-year rolling Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces risk-taking, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 consecutive months, or 3-year rolling Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market tightness that accelerates wage growth and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 60-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During post-shock recovery periods, a rebound in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing sector normalization that improves corporate margins and equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of post-shock recovery instances with INDPRO rebounding above 12-month MA, or 3-year Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with UNRATE > 4.5% for 2 consecutive months, or 3-year rolling Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year increase in CPIAUCSL above 3.0% indicates persistent inflation that triggers delayed monetary policy responses and higher real interest rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of instances with CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%, or 3-year rolling Rank IC < 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and decline in RSAFS indicates inflationary pressure eroding real consumer purchasing power, which reduces corporate profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint movement of CPIAUCSL rising and RSAFS falling fails to produce negative 5-day returns in >55% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: During early-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average signals robust consumer confidence and investment demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of early-cycle expansion instances with HOUST rising above 12-month MA, or 3-year Rank IC < 0.02.
